registered_workload: Detect the encoding of the first 500 sorted files from the official test-data repository and return per-file records in input order.
correctness_requirements: The original project tests must pass except the documented Windows symlink privilege test.
Every per-file detection record must equal the serial result.
Input order and command-line error behavior must be preserved.
The command-line entry point and options must keep working.
constraints: Use only existing dependencies or the Python standard library.
Do not change the registered workload adapter.
Do not hard-code the benchmark file list.
The final claim is based on end-to-end runtime.
